changelog:
Initial release of acceptance-report-gen.

- Generates comprehensive acceptance reports consolidating test results, acceptance conclusions, and performance/security assessments.
- Supports input of detailed test case results, module verdicts, performance and security evaluations, and optional architecture reference.
- Outputs structured reports in 7 chapters: overview, summary, per-module detail, defect list, performance, security, and final conclusion.
- Applies clear standards to determine pass/conditional pass/fail based on test and risk criteria.
- Designed to streamline system acceptance and delivery documentation.
summary: 汇总测试用例执行结果、功能验收结论、性能安全评估，生成完整的系统验收报告，包含测试概述、结果汇总、缺陷清单、验收结论（✅通过/⚠️有条件通过/❌不通过）。
